_schema_notes.category: Cat1=sensor-based (self_report=false, not latent) | Cat2=self-report (self_report=true, not latent) | Cat3=latent (inferred, no observed data)
_schema_notes.state_labels: Discrete state names used by DBN  final output values for the node
_schema_notes.source_column_bins: Per-source-column discretization. Keys = column names. Values = {method, thresholds/bin_edges/value_map, state_labels}. kmeans entries have k+bin_edges auto-filled on first run.
_schema_notes.column_likelihoods: P(col_discretized_value | node_state) lookup tables. Populated by data_likelihood_tables.py after discretization. Used at inference for soft evidence fusion.
_schema_notes.self_report: True = data comes from self-report (survey/EMA) app will ask user at ask_interval_days. False = passive sensor, no prompting
_schema_notes.ask_interval_days: Frequency in days to prompt user. 1=daily, 7=weekly, 30=monthly, 365=once at setup, null=never asked
_schema_notes.high_weight_score: CPT spread score (0.0-1.0) computed post-training. Null until training. Controls daily question priority  higher score = asked sooner when confidence is low
_schema_notes.temporal: True = node has prev_day_* t-1 lag column self-edge across DBN time slices
_schema_notes.source_columns: Post-harmonization column names per dataset that feed this node
_schema_notes.forced_parents: Edges added before structure learning (domain knowledge overrides BIC)
_schema_notes.prior: CPT table populated by data_nhanes_priors.py. Empty until then.

depression.description: PHQ-9 total depressive symptom severity. Shared node: NHANES (phq_total) + StudentLife (phq_total).

bmi.description: Body Mass Index. NHANES: BMI float. LifeSnaps: bmi (numeric after categorical imputation).

age.description: Age in years. NHANES only (LifeSnaps age too coarse  binary 0/1 post-clean). Root node.

sex.description: Biological sex. NHANES: RIAGENDR (1=male, 2=female). LifeSnaps: gender. Root node.

education_level.description: Education level. NHANES EDUCATION (1-5 scale after grade-code remap for 18-19yr olds).

marital_status.description: Marital status. NHANES DMDMARTL: 1 or 6 = married_partnered; 2 = single; 3-5 = separated_divorced_widowed.

diabetes_status.description: Ordinal diabetes status merged from DIQ010/DIQ160/DIQ050. 0=none, 1=prediabetes, 2=diabetes, 3=diabetes+insulin.

chronic_condition.description: Binary: has at least one chronic condition (union of 8 MCQ flags: arthritis, stroke, CHD, heart failure, angina, other heart, COPD, obesity-related).

pain_level.description: Cardiopulmonary symptom burden. CDQ001 (chest pain on exertion) + CDQ010 (shortness of breath). Combined: 0=neither, 1=one symptom, 2=both.

alcohol_use.description: Alcohol consumption. NHANES: ALQ121 (drinking days/yr), ALQ130 (avg drinks per drinking day), ALQ142 (drinks/day past 30d).

smoking.description: Smoking status. SMQ040: 1=daily, 2=some days, 3=not at all (never-smokers set to 3 in data_loading.py). SMD650: avg cigs/day past 30d (NaN for non-smokers).

neuroticism.description: Big Five neuroticism trait (BFI 6-item sum, range 6-30). Administered once at app setup. Root trait node  no parents.

extraversion.description: Big Five extraversion trait (BFI 4-item sum, range 4-20). Administered once at app setup. Root trait node  no parents.

stress_helplessness.description: PSS-4 helplessness subscale (pss_2 + pss_10, range 0-8). Perceived inability to control stressors.

stress_self_efficacy.description: PSS-4 self-efficacy subscale (pss_4 + pss_5, range 0-8). Perceived ability to cope and handle problems. Higher = more in control.

positive_affect.description: PANAS PA subscale: panas_pa (enthusiastic + inspired, range 2-10). Items chosen as unique signal not covered by PHQ/PSS.

negative_affect.description: PANAS NA subscale: panas_na (scared + guilty + hostile, range 3-15). Items chosen as unique signal not covered by PHQ/PSS/mood-EMA.

loneliness.description: UCLA-3 loneliness (lonely_2 + lonely_11 + lonely_14, range 3-12). Tertile thresholds: 3-5=low, 6-9=moderate, 10-12=high.

physical_health.description: VR-12 physical health component (vr_general_health + vr_moderate_activity + vr_physical_limit_work + vr_pain_interference). Monthly survey. Higher = worse.

mental_health.description: VR-12 mental health component (vr_energy + vr_emotional_limit_work + vr_emotional_limit_care + vr_downhearted + vr_social_interference). Monthly survey. Higher = worse.

sleep_quality.description: Daily sleep duration/quality. Primary: sleep_hours (StudentLife passive + LifeSnaps converted from prev_night_minutesasleep / 60). Supplementary: sleep_quality_rating, sleep_latency_mins.

sleep_disturbances.description: PSQI monthly burden score (6 items summed  sleep_disturbances sum). Captures frequency of sleep disruption causes over past month.

sleep_physio.description: Physiological sleep quality from LifeSnaps Fitbit: prev_night_resting_hr (bpm) + prev_night_temperature (degrees C). Passive sensor. Primary: resting_hr.

activity.description: Daily passive physical movement. StudentLife: active_ratio (accelerometer). LifeSnaps: active_ratio + hourly_steps + prev_day_steps (Fitbit). NHANES: PAD680 (sedentary min/day, inverted to active_ratio).

exercise.description: Intentional exercise. StudentLife EMA: exercise_type (0=none/1=walking/2=moderate/3=vigorous). NHANES: PAQ610 (days/wk), PAD615/630/645/660 (structured activity min/day).

heart_rate.description: Hourly heart rate from LifeSnaps Fitbit (hourly_bpm). Passive sensor. Prev_day_bpm is t-1 temporal lag.

screen_usage.description: Daily phone screen time from StudentLife passive sensing. Primary: screen_time_window_minutes. Supplementary: dark_window_minutes, unlocked_window_minutes, yesterday_nighttime_screen_minutes.

communication.description: Daily communication from StudentLife passive sensing: call_count, call_duration_total, sms_count. Primary: call_count.

running_tasks.description: Average background running apps/tasks from StudentLife passive sensing. Proxy for cognitive multitasking load.

mood.description: Daily mood EMA. Primary: mood_how (overall valence rating). Supplementary: mood_happy, mood_sad, and prior-day versions.

stress_ema.description: Daily perceived stress EMA level. Subjective stress at time of prompt.

social_events_positive.description: Count of positive social events the previous day (prev_day_events_positive).

social_events_negative.description: Count of negative social events the previous day (prev_day_events_negative).

mental_stress.description: Latent mental stress state. Inferred from observable indicators.

physical_stress.description: Latent physical stress state. Inferred from observable indicators.

time_of_day.description: Hour-of-day phase derived from device clock (passive sensing). Captures circadian context â€” the same behaviour carries different health implications at different times of day.
